To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
context-based search of a large 3D model database improves the quality of results over keyword search alone.
context-based queries are more effective than keyword searches for 3D scenes, and can be performed without any keywords at all.

(1) context-based queries can improve search results for 3D scenes; (2) we can predict relationships between objects in a scene; and (3) we can use the predicted relationships to perform context-based queries.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: 1) How can we automatically learn to extract tags from the names given to 3D models? 2) What are the most effective features that can be used to predict the relevance of a model in the context of an existing scene? 3) What are the best methods for performing context-based searches?
developing a search engine for 3D scenes that allows designers to find related objects in a large corpus of models.
the development of methods to improve the usability of large databases of 3D objects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
context-based search of large 3D model databases is a promising approach for finding relevant models for a given context.
context-based search can be useful to find relevant 3D models.
we have developed a method for context based search of 3-D models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
context-based search is an effective method for searching a large database of 3D objects, even when there is no keyword information available.
we are able to search for 3d objects in a scene graph by using the object’s context, which includes shape, tags and spatial relationships between objects.
we have developed a method that allows designers to search a database of 3D objects using a 3-D query region and the objects' spatial relationships to one another.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the context of the scene can be used to perform search queries.
the context in which a 3D object appears is a powerful cue for retrieval.
context-based search is a viable method for searching 3D model databases, and that it can be used as a complementary method for searching with keywords.
